beats.line: Ayo kita main bola di taman! Lihat, rumputnya masih hijau segar.
beats.notes: Establishing beat: place the audience in the playground before anything goes wrong.

beats.line: Bobby, bolanya hilang! Tadi ada di dekat bangku itu.
beats.notes: The problem lands, and the ball must be OFF STAGE for it to be a problem. Pip is the one who notices, so Bobby can react. No prop: they are talking about something that is not there.

beats.line: Coba kita pikirkan. Ke mana bola itu menggelinding?
beats.notes: Bobby models problem-solving instead of panicking.

beats.line: Aku tadi melihat bola itu menggelinding ke arah sungai, lewat jalan setapak!
beats.notes: Coco walks in carrying information, not a description: the audience has seen the ball, so she recalls the event instead of re-describing it.

beats.line: Kalau begitu kita ke sungai! Ayo, ikuti aku!
beats.notes: Transition beat. The ball is still lost; the search is the movement. Previously this beat made Bobby throw a ball that was supposed to be missing.

beats.line: Ada di sini! Bolanya tersangkut di antara bunga-bunga ini.
beats.notes: Payoff: the ball appears where the flowers are, and Bobby picks it up. The reveal is what makes the search worth watching — the audience sees the thing they were told was lost.

beats.line: Terima kasih sudah mencari bersama. Kalau sendiri, aku pasti belum menemukannya.
beats.notes: Moral beat, delivered by the character who benefited.

beats.line: Hore! Kita bermain lagi, dan kali ini kita jaga bolanya bersama-sama.
beats.notes: Close on joy, not on the lesson. The ball stays in Bobby's hands: throwing it again would undo the very thing the episode just taught.

concept.logline: Bola Bobby hilang saat bermain di taman, dan ketiga sahabat mencari bersama sampai menemukannya di tepi sungai.
concept.moral: Mencari bersama lebih mudah daripada mencari sendiri.
